components.css: .ds-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;font:400 17px/1.85 Manrope,'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#173b4b);min-height:48px;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;padding:8px 0;text-decoration:none}.ds-link svg{transition:transform .2s}.ds-link:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px)}.ds-link:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#25576b);outline-offset:6px}.ds-link svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex-shrink:0}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){:host *, :host *:before, :host *:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

components.description: Current-section underline; static desktop snippet of the shipped navigation.
components.html: 一起學手沖找喜歡的豆認識露露與阿勳
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--paper,#fbf9f3);color:var(--ink,#173b4b);font:400 17px/1.85 Manrope,'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif}.ds-nav a{padding:10px 0;position:relative;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:after{content:"";height:1px;position:absolute;left:0;right:100%;bottom:6px;background:var(--ink,#173b4b);transition:right .2s}.ds-nav a:hover:after,.ds-nav a[aria-current=location]:after{right:0}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#25576b);outline-offset:6px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){:host *, :host *:before, :host *:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

components.name: Flavor Controls
components.description: Native pressed-state buttons; actual feature replacement is handled by signature.js.
components.css: .ds-tastes{display:flex;gap:40px;background:var(--sky,#cfe4ed);border-bottom:1px solid #173b4b44;color:var(--ink,#173b4b)}.ds-tastes button{position:relative;flex:1;background:none;border:0;padding:18px 5px 22px;font:500 clamp(22px,2vw,30px)/1.6 'Noto Serif TC',serif;color:inherit;opacity:.8;transition:opacity .2s;cursor:pointer}.ds-tastes button:after{content:"";position:absolute;height:3px;bottom:-1px;left:0;right:0;background:var(--ink,#173b4b);transform:scaleX(0);transition:transform .25s}.ds-tastes button[aria-pressed=true],.ds-tastes button:hover{opacity:1}.ds-tastes button[aria-pressed=true]:after{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-tastes button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#25576b);outline-offset:6px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-tastes{gap:10px}.ds-tastes button{font-size:20px;padding:15px 0 19px;line-height:1.7}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){:host *, :host *:before, :host *:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

components.name: Ruled Bean Menu Row

components.css: .ds-bean{display:grid;width:100%;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(0,1fr) 28px;align-items:center;gap:30px;padding:23px 16px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #173b4b44;background:none;color:var(--ink,#173b4b);text-align:left;transition:background .2s;cursor:pointer}.ds-bean strong{font:500 21px/1.7 'Noto Serif TC',serif}.ds-bean>span{font:400 16px/1.8 Manrope,'Noto Sans TC',sans-serif}.ds-bean:hover,.ds-bean[aria-pressed=true]{background:#fbf9f34d}.ds-bean:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#25576b);outline-offset:6px}.ds-bean svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex-shrink:0}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-bean{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 20px;gap:8px 15px;padding:21px 5px}.ds-bean strong{font-size:20px}.ds-bean>span{grid-column:1;grid-row:2}.ds-bean svg{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/3}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){:host *, :host *:before, :host *:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
The Independent Coffee Photography Book uses sky-blue paper, dark blue ink and generous photographic spreads to make a personal coffee ritual feel approachable. Chinese serif headings carry the expressive voice; large sans-serif copy and plain controls keep the practical information easy to read.

This records the implemented signature world in design-signature.html and assets/signature.css, with behavior in assets/signature.js. It applies to future work explicitly extending that world; it does not restyle index.html or the five legacy variants. The build is code-led under delegated creative direction, without an approved visual comp. Preserve the supplied official logo unchanged and keep photographs of the teachers authentic.
keyCharacteristics: Sky blue, warm paper and dark blue ink.
Large Chinese serif headings with readable supporting copy.
Square photographic spreads, overlapping information plates and ruled lists.
Visible flavor selection and direct LINE inquiries.

rules.name: The Logo-to-Paper Rule
rules.body: Use the supplied logo as the identity anchor; carry its sky-blue family into broad paper-like surfaces and retain dark ink for text and actions.

rules.name: The Readable Journal Rule
rules.body: Keep main body copy at 19px on desktop and 18px on phones. Smaller captions and functional labels have their own roles; they are not a substitute for body copy.

rules.name: The Paper Overlap Rule
rules.body: Create structural depth through solid surface overlaps and photographic framing. Keep the small diffuse shadow confined to the open mobile navigation.

dos: Do preserve the official logo and authentic teacher photographs.
Do keep body copy at the documented desktop and phone sizes.
Do use native buttons, visible focus outlines and aria-pressed for flavor and bean selection.
Do keep course and bean inquiry actions leading directly to LINE.
Do disclose illustrative photography and sample catalog content where the implemented page does.
donts: Don't replace the signature world with repeated equal marketing cards or a dark luxury treatment.
Don't fabricate teacher portraits, testimonials, stock promises or equipment gifts.
Don't turn the sample bean menu into a public checkout action.
Don't apply this signature specification retroactively to the legacy variants.
